## Services Offered

### Salon Services
- Hair Coloring (custom color, root touch-ups, color correction)
- Highlights & Balayage (hand-painted balayage, ombré, highlights, lowlights)
- Haircuts & Styling (women's, men's, kids' cuts, blowouts, event styling)
- Waxing (facial and brow waxing)

### Barbershop Services (Bon Air Barbershop)
- Men's Cuts & Fades (skin fade, taper fade, undercut, scissor cuts)
- Beard Trims & Grooming (precision shaping, line-ups, hot-towel service)

## Business Model

Dual-concept facility combining traditional barbershop services with full-service salon offerings under one roof. Expert stylists and barbers serving all ages and genders.

## About

Blown Away Salon and Bon Air Barbershop brings together master barbers and stylists who understand that every cut, color, and style tells your story. We combine traditional barbering craftsmanship with modern salon innovation to deliver results that turn heads. Our Louisville location on Poplar Level Road serves clients across the greater metro area with precision cuts, vibrant color, and personalized grooming.

## Common Questions

Q: Do you accept walk-ins?
A: Yes, we welcome both appointments and walk-ins. Booking ahead is recommended for preferred stylist/barber and time, especially evenings and Saturdays.

Q: What's the difference between barbershop and salon services?
A: The Bon Air Barbershop side specializes in men's cuts, fades, and beard grooming. The salon side offers cuts, color, treatments, and styling for all hair types and genders.

Q: How long does a haircut or color service take?
A: Haircuts take 30–45 minutes. Color services run 1–3 hours based on hair length and desired result.

Q: Do you offer wedding and event styling?
A: Yes, we handle bridal parties, event styling, and special occasion prep. Book in advance and schedule a consultation.

Q: Where are you located?
A: 4218 Poplar Level Road in Louisville's Bon Air area, just off I-264. Free parking on-site. Easy drive from Buechel, Highlands, and Fern Creek.
